title: Quantization Profile Adoption Tracker (by model family + region)
content:
Purpose
- Track quantization_profile adoption by model family + region at a weekly grain.
- This is intended to be JOINed into the unit economics semantic layer to explain blended $/1M output tokens deltas (mix shift vs quant profile rollout).

Key definitions
- quantization_profile: string tag emitted on metering/telemetry events (see PR-11863). Examples: fp16_baseline, fp8_e4m3, int8_w8a8_v2, int4_awq_v3.
- profile_version: versioned suffix where applicable (e.g., int4_awq_v3). If blank, profile has no explicit version.
- pct_requests: share of successful inference requests for the (week_start, model_family, model_variant, region) slice that used this quantization_profile.
- pct_output_tokens: share of OUTPUT tokens for the same slice using this profile (preferred for unit-econ weighting).
- savings_est_gpu_seconds: estimated GPU-seconds saved vs fp16_baseline for the slice (approx; derived from runtime counters + baseline curves).
- savings_est_cost_usd: savings_est_gpu_seconds * blended GPU $/sec for the fleet in that region for that week (this is for directional sanity checks; unit-econ canonical numbers come from the cost attribution pipeline).
- quality_guardrail_status: eval_pass | eval_warn | rollback_triggered | monitoring_only.

Join guidance (for telemetry / unit econ drilldowns)
- Primary join keys (recommended): week_start, model_family, model_variant, region, quantization_profile
- If unit econ dataset is at daily grain, join on week_start = date_trunc('week', day) OR roll up unit econ to weekly for the explain panel.
- If unit econ dataset uses model_name instead of family/variant: map model_name -> model_family/model_variant using the model catalog table maintained by Telemetry (Logan/Nadia).

Notes / caveats
- This tracker uses "successful requests" denominator (HTTP 2xx + completed streams). If you need "attempted requests" include 429/5xx, ask Nadia (we’ve seen this skew during incident weeks).
- Dedicated and Private deployments may not emit quantization_profile consistently prior to 2025-11-01; do not use earlier weeks for exec reporting.
- ap-southeast-1 has smaller sample sizes; we cap driver charts to >= 50k output tokens/week to avoid noisy percentages.

TAB: Mapping / tags sanity checks
- Expected telemetry fields (post PR-11863): quantization_profile, runtime_config, model_family, model_variant, region, customer_tier.
- Common bad values seen in logs:
  - quantization_profile = "" (empty): ingestion gap; treat as fp16_baseline for older runtimes ONLY if runtime_config indicates baseline.
  - quantization_profile = "int4_awq" without version: older config; map to int4_awq_v2 for weeks <= 2025-12-15 (confirm with Jonas before doing any backfill-based analysis).

Owner checklist (weekly)
[ ] Update last week row values by Tuesday EOD (PT)
[ ] If any slice shows eval_warn, document the specific eval + metric and whether it blocks ramp
[ ] If rollout_stage changed, add a note with reason + link to rollout ticket (or Slack thread)
[ ] Flag any region where pct_output_tokens differs from pct_requests by > 10 points (usually indicates long-context / large outputs differ by customer segment)

- 2026-01-14 (Arjun): Created tracker format aligned to weekly unit econ review; standardized model_family/model_variant naming to match model catalog.
